review:
Big Bass Bonanza 1000 is the high-ceiling version of the slot that started the Big Bass series, with wins of up to 20,000x. Three to five scatters award 10, 15 or 20 free spins, and when only two land, a third can be reeled in to trigger the round anyway.

During free spins, the fisherman wild collects every visible fish money symbol, now worth up to 1,000x. Every fourth wild adds 10 more spins and lifts the multiplier to 2x, 3x and finally 10x. Pragmatic lists a 96.51% RTP. It plays exactly like the original, with much bigger fish.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
